violations.why: task_measure3_isr (prio 6) can preempt measure2 between its write of tickCounter=0 and the check, so the check sees a changed value.
The communicate ISR (prio 3) can preempt measure2 (prio 2) between the write and the read and overwrite tickCounter.
measure3 (prio 6) preempts measure1 after it reads the index for records[] and increments numberOfRecords. Measure1 then uses a stale index and its increment reads a changed value.
measure3 increments numberOfRecords between measure1's read and its write-back of numberOfRecords++, so one update is lost.
measure3 (prio 6) can preempt the communicate ISR between its read of numberOfRecords and its reset to 0. The check on the value is then stale.
measure1 (prio 5) can preempt the communicate ISR (prio 3) between its read and its reset of numberOfRecords, so the value it checked is stale.
